correctness.rationale: The starting Deutsch–Sagan condition is on n+1 with its units digit unrestricted. Thus A_r is exactly the disjoint union of 3K_m+s, s=−1,0,1, with binary-digit ternary K_m, in the cyclic ring. The −1 residue at n=3^r−1 is included: n+1=3^r has one permitted leading 1. Binary-digit summands in K_m add without carries and with digit multiplicities 1,2,1, so w_m is the full ordered convolution. The offset sum has multiplicities 1,2,3,2,1 at −2,…,2, giving precisely the two successor terms in the indicated residue classes, including wraparound. Maximal w_m is unique at the all-ones word when m>0; adjacent weights can both be 1 only at the all-twos to all-zeros wrap. These arguments give the extrema and cover m=0 with all three counts equal. Squaring and summing gives 19H_m+8P_m with H_m=6^m and P_0=1; on low digits 0 and 1 the products contribute 2H_(m−1) each, while low digit 2 contributes P_(m−1) by carry. This proves E_r=(127·6^m+8)/5. The compatible law is S+3X with S uniform on −1,0,1 and X an independent fair binary-digit ternary integer. The digits of X_1+X_2 are i.i.d. with probabilities (1/4,1/2,1/4). Their strong-law typical frequency set for digit 1 is Haar-null, and finite affine images scaled by 3 are still Haar-null. Each conditional component is nonatomic and has full support on its corresponding coset, and the offsets cover the three cosets. Finally the cylinder collision sum is E_r/(3·2^m)^4 with rate 3/8 per digit, giving log_3(8/3). A fresh exact Catalan recurrence and ordered modular enumeration checked every target through r=7, not relying on the digit criterion for its input.
